# Coal

[All items](Items.md) · [Crafting guide](Crafting-Recipes.md) · [Home](Home.md)

[How to obtain](#how-to-obtain) · [Crafting and processing](#crafting-and-processing) · [Uses](#used-to-make)

<a href="Item-coal.md" title="Coal"><img src="icons/17.png" width="96" height="96" alt="Coal"></a>

A mined fuel and torch ingredient. It powers a [Furnace](Item-furnace.md) or [Boiler Engine](Item-boiler-engine.md) and is also used to craft batteries.

## At a glance

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Stack size | 64 |
| Furnace fuel duration | 80 seconds |

## How to obtain

Gather by mining [Coal ore](Item-coal-ore.md). Follow each block’s tool requirement.

## Furnace fuel

One item supplies **80 seconds** of burning fuel. Use it in a [Furnace](Item-furnace.md) for smelting or cooking.
